findings.title: Explicit TUI filenames and separate CLI owner already exist
findings.action: Do not repeat the rename or create another CLI tree.

findings.title: Narrow and accurately name build targets
findings.action: The disked_json target currently compiles json, command, protocol, shell_lexer and invocation policy. Extract target responsibilities incrementally or use an honest encompassing name. Keep exact target qualification.

findings.title: Make cross-module includes unambiguous
findings.action: Prefer module-qualified includes and narrow usage requirements. No actual wrong-header binding was reproduced in this review.

findings.title: Consolidate shared frontend invariants, not all frontend code
findings.action: tick, availability and portions of form staging repeat across TUI/GUI. Extend existing presentation helpers with regression coverage; retain different navigation/renderers.

findings.title: Keep composition distinct from repeated command-specific policy
findings.action: Incrementally derive routing/limits from one reviewed service binding, and move test-only synchronization into test support when warranted. Preserve separation of metadata and execution grants.

findings.title: Source-map coverage does not enforce dependencies
findings.action: Current checker detects missing, obsolete and repeated links. Add independent header/dependency boundary checks without creating a second manually maintained source inventory.

findings.title: Root first-task text is stale
findings.action: Route current work through one live work-state summary; retain historical decisions and pending acceptance independently.

findings.title: USK pending maintenance candidate fails hosted qualification
findings.action: Fix and qualify actual repair.apply completion, source-free recovery and required consumers before promotion. Do not solve by raising a deadline without cause analysis.
